title: Circles and π
summary: Circumference, the mysterious number π, and the area of a circle by slicing and rearranging.

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 9: Perimeter and Area

objectives: I can find the circumference and area of a circle.
I can explain what π is.
I can solve problems about wheels, gardens and paths.
misconceptions: Area and circumference use the same formula.
